item: A recorded Library-count failure is tried again when its window ends, even when nothing was written in the meantime
summary: Found by the Opus read of #1439. A failed keyword-mention count is stored with a 900 s window and the tile says it is tried again after 15 min. When the window ended, cached() compared the write probe, saw no write, called the entry verified and only re-stamped checked_at, so on a quiet app (a deadline failure is most likely caused by load, and the load ends when the writes stop) the count was never retried and the tile kept the old failure forever. A value that nothing has written over is still exactly right; a recorded failure is not a value. An entry carrying its own window (__ttl_s__) now starts the compute again when that window ends whatever the probe says. Red without: the probe held constant, the first count raises StatementTimeout, the window is aged past its end, the second poll must start a second count: unfixed it never does.
